content:
deploy-bot: Deploy initiated — canary start for service=runtime-api, env=prod-usw2, tag=v2.12.0, commit=3a1f9b2, canary_traffic=2%, change_window=30m. Runbook: smoke -> metrics -> promote. @arjun @mara please monitor.
arjun: ack. watching smoke logs and traces. will pin to v2.11.8 if we see regressions.
mara: enabling perf SLO checks and distributed tracing for the canary.
deploy-bot: Smoke checks: ✅ p95=140ms, error_rate=0.12%, mem=68%. No obvious GC spikes.
leo: saw 2x 502s from shard-4 around +3m, sample log:
```
2026-03-20T10:12:03Z shard-4 runtime-api ERROR request_id=abc123 upstream_timeout
```
leo: they look like upstream timeouts, not immediate OOMs.
mara: noted. hold at 2% for extra 10m while we correlate with infra metrics.
arjun: digging into the timeout traces — adding a temporary increase to retries for shard-4.
deploy-bot: Traffic update: canary -> 10% (manual step by arjun). Tag pinned as v2.12.0-canary-20260320.
julia.pm: QA quick smoke passed against canary at 10%. No tokenization/regression failures on standard suite.
mara: p95 creeping to ~220ms on one path but stable overall. keeping watch; rollback plan ready (pin v2.11.8-stable).
release-engineering: noted — rollback tag v2.11.8-stable reserved and tested for hot rollback.
deploy-bot: Auto-checks green at +12m. Proceeding with scheduled ramp: promoting to 50%.
arjun: infra telemetry looks OK with 50% — CPU and memory normal across pods.
mara: small error-rate blip at promotion time (0.6%) but rolled back to baseline within 30s; no action required.
deploy-bot: Promotion complete: 50% -> 100% in progress. ETA to full ramp 10m if stability holds.
arjun: go ahead to 100% from my side.
deploy-bot: Canary promotion complete — v2.12.0 promoted to 100% traffic in prod-usw2. Release notes: "runtime: improved KV cache eviction, attention-kernel optimizations, 502 hotfix for upstream timeouts." Release page: https://go/redwood/releases/2.12.0
mara: monitoring: one short burst of errors at promotion boundary but that cleared automatically; no rollback needed.
julia.pm: changelog updated and docs notified. tagging release artifacts and publishing notes.
release-engineering: leaving a pinned rollback branch in case we need it later: `rollback/v2.11.8-stable`.
arjun: nice work everyone :tada:
